name: Caustics
description: Sunlight on the floor of shallow water: a soft network of light that shifts slowly and bends around the pointer.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for how fast the surface moves. 0 holds one frame.

props.name: scale
props.description: Size of the pattern. 2 gives cells twice as wide, as in deeper water.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the light lines from 0 to 1. The pattern stays soft at 1.

props.name: tint
props.description: Colour of the water. By day it tints pale sand; at night it tints deep water lit by the moon. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the water. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the water. The pointer still bends the light through it.
